reason: The plugin provides a model-driven /init command that analyzes a repository, generates or updates AGENTS.md, and adds ongoing AGENTS.md maintenance guidance to agent sessions, making memory and context management its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过模型驱动的 /init 命令分析项目并生成或更新 AGENTS.md，为智能体提供持续维护的仓库上下文。
summaries.en: Uses a model-driven /init command to analyze a project, generate or update AGENTS.md, and maintain repository-specific context for the agent.

capabilities: analyzes repository content to derive project guidance
injects maintenance instructions into the agent system prompt
